name: editor-vendor
description: Browser JS dependencies for the blog editor, bundled locally so the app never fetches from a CDN at runtime.

scripts.build: esbuild src/codemirror.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=vendor/codemirror.js && cp node_modules/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/highlight.min.js vendor/highlight.min.js && cp node_modules/@highlightjs/cdn-assets/styles/github.min.css vendor/highlight-github.min.css
